container.platform: Linux x86-64, Python 3.12.3, Podman/Rosetta on Apple M3 Pro
container.pybdsf_scope: Released integration dependency only, not the pinned-master performance gate

defaults.decision: Maintainer's interim choice of 13 October 2026 from Hebog plan task 21: closest of the four lanes to pinned PyBDSF master's sky-model filtering (92.8% agreement against a 99.5% target; released PyBDSF 99.29%); decided again after plan task 75

implementation.distributed_path: Deferred to source-finder plan task 72 by maintainer approval on 2026-10-12
implementation.hebog_version: 0.22.0, the wheel published on PyPI (its SHA-256 matches PyPI's)
implementation.layout: One single-threaded Dask worker per node; native ThreadExecutor inside the Prefect task
implementation.memory_reservation: hebog.analysis_memory_bytes for the sources hebog.expected_source_count estimates from the detection image at threshpix; an ExecutorAdmissionError, when no memory remains for the tile tasks or one needs more than remains, falls back to PyBDSF (Hebog plan task 77, decided 14 October 2026)
implementation.publication: On a branch of https://git.astron.nl/RD/rapthor; not merged

memory_estimate.bound: Bounded the most sources any profile/background lane published on all 21 quick-check, Rapthor-agreement and task-23 cases, at 1.0 to 21 times; 1.1 to 1.9 on the LOFAR and simulated SKA fields; 21 on wide-extended-source
memory_estimate.scope: Development machine, native macOS; the agreement lanes from run task23-pin-st and the benchmark count from run task23-first; no separate evidence record

profile_smoke.limitation: Three isolated sources, identical true/apparent input; catalogue-cut checks only, not component-retention agreement or task-21 safety strata

quick_science_check.result: no regressions; all 54 catalogue, RMS and mask FITS products byte-identical

reproduce.native_integration: See scripts/validation/containers/rapthor/README.md; tests are archived in the pinned Rapthor commit

scope: Current-layout integration with the compact/zero defaults, the image-sized memory reservation and the PyBDSF fallback, at the Rapthor and LSMTool pins of 17 October 2026; no scientific or performance qualification

upstream_audit.result: Pin move of 17 October 2026. Rapthor main gained one commit (aff26023, an array-beam option) that changes nothing in the filter step. LSMTool master gained twelve commits that refactor skymodel.py and tableio.py (private helpers renamed, _get_xy faster) and leave filter_skymodel/, the mask lookup and the test resources unchanged; its declared dependencies are the same. The change rebases onto aff26023 without conflict.

archived_container_tests.command: podman run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --workdir /opt/rapthor-source localhost/hebog-rapthor:task79 python -m pytest -q tests/execution/test_hebog_filter.py tests/execution/test_skymodel_filter.py
archived_container_tests.scope: No checkout mount; committed source and installed dependencies from the final image

validation.hebog_release_check: The 0.22.0 candidate's release check of 15 October 2026: just ci, 3,894 tests passed, 97.40% branch-aware coverage
validation.installed_workflow: Outside the archived checkout, both modules import from site-packages, and the dual-run, default-profile, memory-fallback and image-reservation native tests pass; see the container README for the exact command.

lsmtool_filter_check.command: check_lsmtool_filter.py --image localhost/hebog-lsmtool:156ae6a --executors serial --profile continuum --background estimated, reusing the products of the whole LoTSS-Deep DR2 ELAIS-N1 sector from run lsmtool-check-elais-n1-t022-continuum-2
lsmtool_filter_check.result: 2,314 components, 1,913 kept, 1,460 patches, 201 clipped, no failures, as with 9bac2f7; both sky models identical apart from their history timestamps

native_parset_cli.command: python -m pytest -q tests/execution/test_hebog_filter.py tests/execution/test_skymodel_filter.py tests/lib/test_parset.py tests/lib/test_parset_option_behavior.py tests/lib/test_parset_option_coverage.py --cov=rapthor.execution.image.hebog_filter --cov-branch
